# Code Anchors: Pull-Request Verdict Answers

- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/verdict-items.ts` — numbers departures, findings and deferred-scope proposals against the registry, which it reads from the pull request's own repository, decides each departure's severity, applies the answers, and counts only open items (#886)
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/verdict-items.spec.ts` — pins that an item found again keeps its ID, that no number is reused, that an item not found again stays listed with its answer, and that the registry is read from the pull request's repository (#886)
- `libs/pr-acceptance/src/judgments-block.ts` — the second machine block that lists the items and serves as the ID registry, with the escaping that keeps copied answer text from changing how either block parses
- `libs/pr-acceptance/src/judgments-block.spec.ts` — pins the refusal of a block where one ID names two items, and answer text carrying markers or backtick runs
- `libs/pr-acceptance/src/waiver.ts` — reads the answer lines in the same comment pass as close's waivers, under the same trust rule, and never reads a verdict as an answer
- `libs/pr-acceptance/src/waiver.spec.ts` — pins the answer line forms, the untrusted author, and the comment that carries a verdict marker
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/answer-scope.ts` — decides whether the answer-recording run stops, judges in full, reads no code, or judges again only what a moved head's changed files affect
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/answer-scope.spec.ts` — pins each mode, including the full run when the epic-level state changed or the earlier verdict recorded no results
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/landed-change.ts` — compares each head's own change file by file, so a trunk merge or a rebase marks no file changed
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/publish-check.ts` — refuses a verdict whose counts differ from its open items, and drops only the results' file lists when the body is too large
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — the verbs that number items, write the answer-recording scope, and list the answer comments or the answer lines on a pull request (#886)
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.spec.ts` — pins the listing of answer lines, one row per line, beside the listing of comment links (#886)
- `components/commands/nxs.analyze.md` — the answer form the engineer posts and the answer-recording run that publishes a new complete verdict
- `utils/implement-epic.sh` — the unattended implement loop, which stops when a fix round adds or changes an answer line, detected by comparing the lines rather than comment links or time (#886)
- `libs/portable-tools/src/analyze-answers.spec.ts` — pins how the stage applies trusted answers and names those that apply nothing
- `libs/portable-tools/src/analyze-resolve.spec.ts` — pins the answer-recording run's scope as the stage states it
- `libs/portable-tools/src/implement-epic.spec.ts` — pins that the implement loop stops on a posted answer and on an answer edited into an existing comment (#886)
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/verdict-items.spec.ts` — pins that a concept-invariant departure is high, not critical, and blocks until answered (#903)
